title: linux: shrink a bloated image and fix a broken layer cache
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: Un'immagine container e' enorme e la cache dei layer non funziona, rallentando ogni build. Riduci la dimensione e ripristina la cache. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: shrink a bloated image and fix a broken layer cache

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'shrink a bloated image and fix a broken layer cache'
expected_reasoning: Image bloat + cache misses come from build order and layer hygiene, not the base image alone.
Analyze layer sizes and cache invalidation points; reorder so stable layers precede volatile ones.
Use multi-stage / cleanup within a layer; verify size drop and cache hits.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: shrink a bloated image and fix a broken layer cache
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'shrink a bloated image and fix a broken layer cache' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: shrink a bloated image and fix a broken layer cache

possible_mistakes: Add a bigger disk instead of fixing the image.
Delete files in a later layer (space stays in the earlier one).
hints: A cleanup in a later layer doesn't shrink earlier layers.
Order Dockerfile so dependencies cache before code.
alternative_solution: Use a distroless/minimal base and copy only artifacts in.
edge_cases: A secret baked into an early layer persists even if deleted later.
goal: Un'immagine container e' enorme e la cache dei layer non funziona, rallentando ogni build. Riduci la dimensione e ripristina la cache.
